title: Affine Geometry of Gaussian ReLU Networks via Conditional Kac-Rice Formulas
summary: We study how the affine geometry of finite ReLU networks is created at random initialization and reorganized by supervised training. We call a sign-changing zero of a hidden preactivation an activation switch and a point where the scalar network output is nondifferentiable a scalar kink. For one-dimensional input, conditioning on the preceding layers makes each preactivation Gaussian and affine on the cells of a random finite partition.
